_comment: HAND-AUTHORED and NOT generated. --spark-synchronize-model leaves it alone: SparkUser is not a
context root, so the synchronizer never discovers it and never rewrites this file.
It exists so that Question/Answer CreatedBy and ModifiedBy render the user name instead of a raw
document id: a reference resolves its label through the target type's breadcrumb (#264, G-Q15).
security.json grants Read/SparkUser to both well-known groups -- the breadcrumb is resolved for
visitors too -- and DENIES Read on every attribute here but UserName to both groups, so a
/spark/po/load of a user shows nobody anything but the name. Only the profile fields below are
declared, and only so the deny has something to deny: credential material (PasswordHash,
SecurityStamp, AuthenticatorKey, recovery codes, tokens, logins, passkeys, claims) is never
declared, because an attribute that is not in the model cannot reach the wire whatever a right says.
⚠️ Anything added here is readable by every caller unless security.json denies it as well.
